title: Reservations
description: Requests and bookings: approval, rescheduling, cancellation and visit status.
forbidden: You are not allowed to see reservations.
empty_description: Add the first booking from the panel; online requests appear here too.
create_description: Free times follow the business's rules; a panel booking is confirmed at once and paid at the business.
detail_not_found: The reservation was not found or you cannot see it.
action_dialog.accept: The request is accepted; for online payment the customer is asked to pay.
action_dialog.reject: The request is rejected and its time is freed.
action_dialog.cancel: The booking is cancelled and its time is freed.
action_dialog.start: The customer arrived; the service starts.
action_dialog.complete: The visit is closed as completed.
action_dialog.no_show: The customer did not come; the time stays booked in the history.
customer_dialog.title: New customer
customer_dialog.description: A name and contact are enough; edit the rest on the customer's page.
form.section_where_desc: Where the visit happens and who comes.
form.section_services_desc: Services run one after another; without a choice anyone free is assigned.
form.section_time_desc: Only free start times are shown.
form.section_notes_desc: The customer's note and an internal note only the team sees.
fields.note_hint: Optional; shown in the reservation's history.
slots.pick_first: Pick a branch, services and a day first.
slots.load_failed: Free times could not be loaded.
slots.closed: The branch is closed that day
slots.too_far: That day is not open for booking yet
slots.too_soon: It is too late for that day
detail.hold_expires: Unless decided by {{at}}, this request is cancelled on its own and its time is freed.
reschedule.description: Pick a new free time for the same services; the old time is freed once the new one is taken.
reschedule.service_deleted: One of the services was deleted, so this booking cannot be moved. Cancel it and book again.
period.label: Period
validation.note_max: A note is at most 2000 characters.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Day or week by person, resource or branch. Click free space to book; drag a visit to move it.
calendar.load_failed: The calendar could not be loaded.
calendar.no_staff: No one works in this branch yet. Add staff and assign them to the branch.
calendar.no_resources: This branch has no resources. Add chairs, tables or rooms.
calendar.move_description: The visit moves to the dropped time; if that time is not free, nothing changes.
bulk_cancel.title: Cancel {{count}} reservations
bulk_cancel.description: The reason is written to each reservation's history. Anything that is not a request or an active booking is skipped.
bulk_report.description: {{succeeded}} succeeded, {{skipped}} skipped, {{failed}} failed. The reservations left unchanged are listed below.
bulk_report.reasons.invalid_transition: Not allowed in its current state
bulk_report.reasons.stale: Changed after the list was loaded
agenda.title: My schedule
agenda.description: Where and when you work today, and the visits you serve.
agenda.no_shift: You have no shift on this day.
agenda.empty_description: Nothing is assigned to you on this day.
agenda.no_staff_description: Ask your manager to link your account to a staff record to see your schedule.
agenda.load_failed: The schedule could not be loaded.
errors.other_staff: A colleague also serves this visit; you can change only your own service.
errors.taken: The chosen time is no longer free. Pick another time.
errors.stale: The visit changed while you were looking. The page was refreshed; try again.
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the visit's current state.
